confidence_notes: Dambulla price listings and Sri Lanka-level Numbeo data support the meal, beer and coffee estimates. Accommodation sources differ: one reports a $24 median for three-star hotels and Booking.com reports $48 on average. A Dambulla bar menu showed beer at LKR 450 and cocktails at LKR 550–1,650, but no wine-glass price; cocktail and wine anchors are less certain and use their local price relationship to beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used Dambulla-specific food and accommodation prices where available, with Sri Lanka-level restaurant prices as a cross-check; no substitute city was needed.
